title: Built in Chrome, not drawn
question: The first build of the soft-white nutrition screen, captured at phone size from the real app - real data, real Hebrew day, real components. Compare it with the comp beside it and tell me what to fix.

options.label: The build, top of the screen
options.thesis: The tubes on their raised panel, with the fill colours sampled straight out of the comp you approved and an empty channel that stays neutral. The panel, the header, the day switch and the buttons are all the one material now.
options.viewport: Header, day switch, the four tubes, the diet-quality card.
options.risk: The screen has parts the comp never had - a History/Today/Recipes/Profile switch, a diet-quality card, a two-tab bar with the journal button in the middle. Those are the app, not the drawing.

options.label: The build, scrolled down
options.thesis: The write-line is the one lit thing on the screen, with a warm light escaping from behind its whole edge and a small amber disc for its icon. Under it the meals, on one panel, with the rules between rows made of light instead of ink.
options.viewport: The lit write-line, today's meals, the tab bar.
options.risk: The plus button still floats over the tab bar, and the water card sits further down than in the comp.

options.label: The comp, for comparison
options.thesis: What we are aiming at. Not a build - a drawing, with icons the app does not have and a meals list that is really three fixed rows.
options.risk: Choosing this one means 'keep drawing', which is the thing that stopped working.
